editions.label: Copper rain / Mallow
guide: Delivery

Mallow, the lamp courier • director exposure boards and artist cels. Two cast editions use the same approved poses and facing. Imported attachments live only in this browser inbox; a fresh unprepared app has no delivery.
Read the drawings

Read each board column top to bottom, beats 1–7. The drawn silhouette, hands, beak, scarf and lamp define the pose. Match them to the labelled atlas; atlas order is inventory, NOT performance order. Boards are pencil editorial drawings, not cel exports. A bent arrow at a turn means the next drawing changes facing; it adds no extra beat.
Facing & stage

Front means the audience view shown in the drawing, not a camera behind the character. Right / left means screen right / left. Every atlas cel is drawn facing right (beak and lamp side); left presentation mirrors the entire cel. The logical stage is 160 × 180, with floor at y=150 and pivot at (80,150). Preserve the whole cel and pivot when mirroring (x becomes 160−x). Display scale, borders and surrounding UI may vary; do not crop, rotate or retime artwork internally.
Exposures

Each numbered drawing is one keyed beat. “×N” is N animation frames for that beat. “HOLD +H” adds H more frames of the same drawing and facing. Imported clip timing and board notation agree. Beat start is included; its end is excluded. A time exactly on a boundary shows the next beat. Time is measured in frames; seconds = frame / fps.
Transport

Step moves one frame, not one keyed beat. Scrub accepts fractional, zero and negative frames. With Loop on, normalize using positive modulo over the total exposure. With Loop off, clamp to [0,total−1]; at either endpoint playback stops. Reverse changes the sign of playback and Step only, never beat order or facing. Play advances continuously at the edition fps × rate multiplier. Pause freezes; Reset transport returns frame 0, forward, paused, without changing Loop or saved edits.
Editing

Edit clip opens a draft for the selected edition and clip. Change a selected beat’s base exposure (1–12), extra hold (0–12), clip start frame (0–total−1) or rate multiplier (0.5–2). Draft values preview immediately, paused at the draft start; changing the edited beat alone does not move time. Save commits all draft fields together and selects that start. Cancel restores saved settings and the pre-edit frame. Undo restores the previous saved clip settings, including start and rate, and selects that start. Reset clip restores the received timing, start 0 and rate 1; it is undoable. No edit changes the approved pose or facing.
Persistence

Only saved clip settings and their Undo history persist. Ordinary reload keeps the imported inbox and saved edits, discards drafts and opens the selected edition/clip at its saved start, paused forward. Edition/clip switches discard a draft and select the saved start. Each edition has independent edits and history, despite sharing the approved pose integration. A rebuild/reset-to-scene starts a fresh imported delivery.
Review

Open Received → Guide, either board sheet, or either atlas sheet. Fit shows the complete sheet; tap a named panel for readable detail, use Previous/Next, or Zoom and scroll/pan. Both editions are available from Edition. Inspector and contact strip must agree with the actual moving sprite, including edits and endpoint behavior.
